Name: DE-Products
Statement:
select  cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        pro.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn
from    CommercialClientProduct pro
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = pro.CommercialClient
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = pro.Brand
